series_annotator.narrative: The series exhibits a clear downward trend with moderate seasonality. Concept drift and unstable model rankings necessitate a weighted combination strategy with dynamic error adaptation. High regularization is recommended due to limited validation folds.

reasoning.ade_dynamic_error_beta0.5_trim0.8: series_profile.model_landscape.concept_drift=true → concept drift necessitates dynamic error weighting; ADE-inspired methods adapt to changing model performance
reasoning.inverse_rmse_weights_k4_sh0.35: series_profile.combination_recommendation.top_k=4 AND series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high → high shrinkage (0.35) and top_k=4 aligns with recommended knobs for regularization
reasoning.best_per_horizon_by_validation: series_profile.model_landscape.horizon_homogeneous=false → different models dominate at different horizons; per-horizon selection captures this structure

excluded_highlights.ridge_stacking_l250_topk3: series_profile.combination_recommendation.regularization=high AND n_windows=2 → ridge stacking overfits with few validation windows
